definitions.gloss: shishito pepper; small wrinkled green pepper
definitions.explanation: A small, slender, mostly mild green pepper popular in Japanese cuisine. Usually grilled, fried, or simmered. Occasionally a single pepper turns out spicy.

examples.japanese: ししとう⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}いて→焼く：01123_yaku⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I grilled and ate some shishito peppers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ししとう⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I included shishito peppers in the tempura too.

examples.japanese: {十|じゅっ}{本|ぽん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一|いっ}{本|ぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧くらい⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{激辛|げきから}→激辛：19465_gekikara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ししとう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: About one in ten shishito peppers turns out to be unexpectedly fiery.

notes:
Short for ししとうがらし ({獅子唐辛子|ししとうがらし}, "lion's-head pepper"), named for the wrinkled tip resembling a lion's mane. Usually mild but occasionally hot, which is part of its appeal in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ししとう⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to grill shishito peppers
- ししとう⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧: shishito tempura
- ししとう{炒|いた}め: stir-fried shishito
- ⟦{激辛|げきから}→激辛：19465_gekikara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ししとう: an unexpectedly spicy shishito

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ピーマン→ピーマン：11132_piiman⟧: green bell pepper — much larger, no heat
- ⟦{唐辛子|とうがらし}→唐辛子：11871_tougarashi⟧: chili pepper — generic term; usually much hotter
- {万願寺|まんがんじ}とうがらし: manganji pepper — larger Kyoto variety, similar mild flavor
